It's craftsmanship is sloppy, but it's light and easy to use.|Inventory|TotK}}{{Name Ref|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 12 |durability = 20 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Boko Bow}} Spiked Boko Bows are [[Bow]]s used by [[Blue Bokoblin]]s in the [[Faron Grasslands]] and [[East Necluda]]. They are [[Boko Bow]]s that have been upgraded with [[Animal]] bone to increase their [[Durability]] and strength. Though they are sloppily made, they are light and easy to use. These Bows belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Being made of wood, Spiked Boko Bows will burn if they touch [[Fire]] or if they are equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they are incompatible with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Spiked Boko Bows do not attract [[Lightning]] or [[Electricity]] like metal [[Weapon]]s do during [[Thunderstorm]]s. If scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune, the {{BotW}} Series [[Bokoblin]] [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Spiked Boko Bow. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_003" |Life = 20 |Power = 12 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 13.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 2 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Spiked Boko Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 12 |durability = |flammable = Yes |magnetic = |buoyant = Yes |conductive = |guardian = }} Spiked Boko Bows appear in {{TotK}}.
